subject: IGT status: variance reduction is real, wall-clock story is mixed
body:
Ximena, Bao,

Status. Main comparison is done on the harness. Headline: IGT with anytime averaging cuts across-seed variance of validation accuracy by ~40% at matched step counts versus our default momentum config, and the tail_fraction sweep shows the effect is robust between 0.3 and 0.7. The eval_igt mode (true parameters from the slots, not the shifted variables) was essential - measured on shifted parameters the 'benefit' looks 2x larger than it really is, which is exactly the kind of overstatement the trust-theory portfolio exists to catch.

The mixed news: per-step overhead from maintaining the transport is ~8%, so at matched wall-clock the variance win shrinks to ~30%. Still real, but the memo has to quote wall-clock numbers or we're kidding ourselves.

Risk to the date: one lr_decay_step_fraction interaction produces occasional late-training spikes on 2 of 20 runs; Halima is isolating it this week. If it's config-specific we exclude that cell with a note; if it's inherent, the recommendation gets a caveat.

Efe
